verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of a SaaS messaging platform like Brevo, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents official SDKs (Node.js, Python, PHP), a Postman workspace, an MCP integration, an n8n node and llms.txt. None of these is a command-line tool, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
